sources.title: Interrupt cache configuration
sources.supports: Philip Ng and Anil Kumar (Austin, TX) are named inventors; AMD/ATI affiliation; application 18/145457 filed 2022-12-22; prior publication US20240211300A1 on 2024-06-27.

sources.title: Interrupt cache configuration
sources.read_scope: Detailed Description, particularly overview and descriptions of Figures 2–4; claims
sources.supports: Finite hot-set interrupt cache coalesces repeated vectors using counters and timers; eviction emits an interrupt message instead of dropping the event.
sources.limitation: Patent mechanism; no verified implementation, silicon result or commercial adoption.

sources.title: Devices, systems, and methods for direct cache injection in networking devices
sources.read_scope: Bibliographic record, Detailed Description opening, figure descriptions, claims 18–20
sources.supports: AMD/Xilinx application names Anil Kumar (Austin, TX) among nine joint inventors. Cache-resource identifier and locality hint steer coherent writes toward a host cache; driver programming uses host topology.
sources.limitation: Application, not established grant or deployment. Identity bridge to intended person remains unresolved.

sources.title: Protocol enhancements for low latency applications
sources.read_scope: Bibliographic record, Detailed Description opening, figure descriptions and claims
sources.supports: AMD/Xilinx application names Anil Kumar (Austin, TX) in the same nine-person team. Device push-write sends data without waiting for a host command; CQID/UQID associate data and requests, with credit-based flow control.
sources.limitation: Application, not established deployment. Do not automatically count separately from direct-cache-injection project.

independent_work_assessment.reason: Interrupt-coalescing cache and network cache-directed coherent writes address distinct mechanisms and have different filing dates and co-inventor sets. They are strong candidates for two independent works once personal identity is resolved.
independent_work_assessment.family_caveat: Complete patent-family verification remains pending. The two network applications share the same inventor team and may belong to one broader project; do not count different application numbers alone as independent works.
